Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075144. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary filtering by target ChEMBL ID. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule identifiers and canonical SMILES. Filter rows where standard type is IC50, standard relation is '=', and pChEMBL value is not null. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows preserving row multiplicity.
